notes: The Item 7 (targeted) section was empty, so no MD&A paragraphs matched the theme terms. Several mentions were treated as non-qualifying. 'Community support' is a user help forum. 'Accessibility across several devices' means device compatibility, not disability access. AWS datacenters in several countries count as international operations only. 'Simple and intuitive design' is product design. 'Create content' refers to general productivity documents (Paper, doc scanner), so it falls under the 'content' trap. The DBX Developer Platform (just over 1,000,000 registered developers) is a third-party app ecosystem; it is not framed as helping founders start or grow businesses, so it was not scored for Entrepreneurship. Family formation, adoption and surrogacy assistance, and paid parental leave benefits are disclosed but not described as inclusion practices for any group, so they were not scored for Cross-cultural. A human reviewer may want to reconsider this borderline call. The AI Academy launched in 2025 is employee development, covered under the same theme as E3.
